digest.component_or_area: LLM structured run and prompt cache warning
propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective fires on every small call below the 4096-token cache floor even when caching is demonstrably working, generating ~20 false warnings per rebar review-plan run
The warning cannot distinguish 'model does not cache' from 'prompt below the cacheable floor' because its predicate checks only input_tokens > 0 without an upper-open lower bound
Below 4096 tokens zero read and zero write cache counters are correct expected behavior, not a symptom of a caching defect
The fix gates the warning on input_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS (4096), eliminating false positives while preserving detection of genuine cache failures above the floor
CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS constant must be moved to a shared definition in capabilities.py rather than duplicated between pass1.py and structured_run.py
